selections.rationale: One bounded test-only correction; preserve r8 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Add a tiny exact-distance boundary test: viewer at (0,0), maximumDistance=Integer.MAX_VALUE, one visible spot at (Integer.MAX_VALUE,1) and one at (Integer.MAX_VALUE,0). Require exclusion of the first and inclusion of the second, preserving input order and prescribed color. The first squared distance exceeds the squared radius by exactly one; do not use floating-point tolerance to derive the expected inclusion. Retain extreme int-coordinate differences, Long.MAX_VALUE radius, zero radius, negative palette phases, invalid invisible rows, fixed-color validation even in rainbow mode, and independent two-dimensional output. Do not allocate large arrays or impose a new radius cap.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r8 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Add accepted collection implementations: Set.of() with empty and nonempty assets must return all assets in original order; Set.of("photo") must filter matching groups; a TreeSet of valid group strings must also work. Keep a HashSet containing null as an invalid input even with empty assets. Returned selection lists remain independently mutable. Preserve complete asset validation before an early matching find, first matching duplicate-ID identity, exact case-sensitive group matching, positive IDs and nonempty rather than nonblank strings. Do not inspect private fields or require an unpromised immutable implementation layout.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r8 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Remove assertions requiring invalid permission elements to be rejected by Change construction alone. Enclose construction together with apply in each such exception check, preserving the approved apply-time permission-validation scope. With an existing valid group, DELETE permissions containing zero, a negative ID, or null must cause IllegalArgumentException without mutating initial state. Include successful DELETE controls with null, empty and valid-positive permission collections; non-null DELETE collections are not exempt from element validation. Retain CREATE/REPLACE rules, sequential transaction failure atomicity, duplicate collapse, sorted deeply unmodifiable output and input isolation. Also check malformed REPLACE permission elements through construction plus apply rather than requiring an earlier constructor exception. Do not assert private fields or an unspecified secondary error priority.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r8 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Omit the assertion about a standalone newline payload. Do not replace it with either an acceptance or rejection requirement, and do not introduce a new newline policy. Preserve empty-string input as an empty immutable feed; a valid nonempty feed with one trailing newline remains accepted. Keep rejection of extra or missing pipe separators, blank fields, interior blank lines, two trailing newlines after a record, carriage returns and leading/trailing whitespace including Unicode edge whitespace. Keep line order, duplicates, opaque nonpipe URLs, immutable output and no normalization, decoding or scheme restrictions beyond the specification.
